## HN discussion (0 comments)

(no comments)
{"decision": "push", "reason": "页面描述了一个具体的小产品：输入任意美国地址即可生成场地基础图（地块线、等高线、土壤、洪泛区、湿地，并可导出 AutoCAD/SketchUp/Civil 3D/GIS 格式），且免费无需账号，面向建筑、测绘等垂直领域，有实际示例文件可查看，属于有明确需求和专业质感的产品。"}

verdict.reasoning: Every claim in the reason matches the page: it generates a base plan from any US address with parcel lines, contours, soils, flood zones and wetlands, exports to AutoCAD, SketchUp, Civil 3D and GIS, is free with no account, and links an example PDF and files. Those concrete features support the push decision; calling the audience architecture and surveying is a reasonable inference from the CAD and layer focus.
